Method of Attack: Software patch (Java Archive JAR) disables biometric authentication (fingerprint and iris scan), disables GPS tracking, reduces iris scanner sensitivity allowing login with a picture, enabling unauthorized addition of entries into Aadhaar database
Impacted Systems: Aadhaar enrollment software platform (ECMP) used by Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI)
Attack Vector: Unauthorized use of enrollment client software with patched JAR file bypassing biometric authentication and GPS location checks
Indicators of Compromise: Availability of patched Java Archive (JAR) file advertised on YouTube
Login credentials of authorized Aadhaar enrollment agents sold for as little as $35
